contract.design_status: specified after v2 results and cached v3 baseline were inspected, before this perturbation pass
contract.population: every detection in the pinned cached-image pass, regardless of baseline QC; source universe and unprocessed photos remain in the upstream ledger
contract.selection: no taxon, coordinate, environmental association or baseline-phenotype selection
contract.pixel_operations: apply to the entire EXIF-oriented source image before cropping; BGR uint8; intensity/gain/power followed by numpy.rint, clipping to 0..255 and uint8 conversion; gamma operates on encoded sRGB values, not linear-light exposure
contract.geometry: bbox shifts use the original unpadded box width/height. Preserve head padding 0.12 and context padding 0.8. Round lower crop bounds down and upper bounds up. Clip at image boundaries and record clipping. Resolution uses OpenCV INTER_AREA with rounded positive image dimensions and actual x/y scale factors for all boxes; never upsample.
contract.context: exclude the union of all detected head-padded boxes; only the focal box shifts for bbox perturbations; all boxes scale for resolution changes
contract.baseline_gate: exact endpoint-array agreement with the saved baseline is required for each head before interpreting its perturbations; any mismatch stops new scheduling and makes the run incomplete
contract.retain: all 27 endpoint slots per scheduled head and condition, original/mirror values, QC transitions, engine/worker errors, transform/crop recipe, transformed pixel identity, mask identities and paired context diagnostics
contract.mask_storage: baseline mask files remain saved; transformed masks have exact dimension-aware pixel hashes and are reconstructible from immutable source pixels, transform recipes and pinned measurement code
contract.dependence: join the pinned observation/photo/exact-content connected components; summarize repeated heads within image then images within component; report historical development exposure separately
contract.summary: report all conditions and endpoints, baseline eligibility and paired eligibility, lost/gained QC, absolute and signed changes, group-weighted distributions and descriptive rank agreement where estimable; hue and colour fractions additionally require joint circular/compositional summaries
contract.decision: do not set a favourable rank-correlation threshold after seeing results or turn this pass into a claim of absolute accuracy; retain large changes, unavailable comparisons and quality failures
limits: Synthetic perturbations characterize sensitivity to specified pixel/crop operations, not the full distribution of real photographic errors.
These settings are stress probes, not calibrated camera uncertainty or physical illumination interventions.
Stable ranks can coexist with large systematic shifts and selective loss of difficult images.
Shared-source grouping does not prove independent individuals or find all near-duplicate scenes.
The existing detector was pseudo-label-trained; technical repeatability does not establish detector precision/recall or calibrated biological accuracy.

parameters.context_exclusion: union of every detector head-padded box, intersected with this context
parameters.paired_colour: same OpenCV uint8 Lab/hue statistics on union floral pixels, all non-head context and green non-head context; no dominant-colour switching
parameters.legacy_chroma: unchanged engine 56: redmagenta-only when dominant redmagenta, otherwise union floral pixels
parameters.primary_qc: legacy mirror quality plus both values finite, registry bounds and minimum pixel dimension; retain all raw values
parameters.extended_qc: engine 89 endpoint-specific mirror, geometry, resolution and sharpness flags plus registry bounds
